200.25.15.4(1).explanation: Transition rule: the listed parking regulations do not stop a project whose complete site plan application was filed on or before July 22, 2022, if it complies with the listed 970.10.15 regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read then, and with approved minor variances.

200.25.15.4(2).explanation: Transition rule: the listed accessible parking regulations do not stop a project whose complete site plan application was filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, if it complies with the listed 970.10 regulations or the by-law as it read then, and with approved minor variances.

200.25.15.4(3).explanation: A complete application for site plan approval, for this transition, means one that meets City of Toronto Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

200.25.15.4(4).explanation: For a qualifying project, site plan approval may be granted, and a building permit then issued, if it complies with the listed 970.10 parking regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read when the application was filed (on or before July 22, 2022, or between July 22, 2022 and March 31, 2025), the City of Toronto Act, the site plan approval and approved minor variances.
